thread:
Mia: quick ask — can someone run a parity smoke on vpc-node-7 in staging? p95 looks ~120ms higher than prod. @Sam tagging you because you touched the NIC configs last week
Sam: on it. which bench did you run?
Mia: the nightly bench: ./bench.sh --target vpc-node-7 --seq 512 --runs 100. snippet: ```./bench.sh --target vpc-node-7 --seq 512 --runs 100```
Priya: also verify MTU and offloads (GRO/LRO/XPS). we had drift when hosts rebuilt with different kernel flags
Sam: kicked off a run, PerfBot will post results here. ETA ~12m
PerfBot: Bench results for vpc-node-7 — p50: 23ms, p95: 308ms (+120ms vs prod). logs: https://logs.redwood/internal/2039998888/bench.out
Alex: can we get a flamegraph? want to check KV cache vs scheduler tails
Mia: uploading flamegraph now, give me a sec
Jordan: also check /proc/interrupts and ethtool — last time IRQs weren't pinned and rx queues were handled on busy cores
Sam: preliminary look: interrupts skewed, rx queues not pinned. commands I ran: `ethtool -k eth0` and `cat /proc/interrupts | grep eth0`
Priya: suggested immediate mitigation: enable XPS/RPS and pin IRQs to dedicated cpus. runbook: https://redwood.ops/runbooks/vpc-nic-tuning
Mia: applied a test patch on staging node: set rps_cpus mask to f and pinned irq 32-39 to cpu1-4, re-running bench now
PerfBot: New run complete — p50: 20ms, p95: 190ms (improved). still ~2ms above prod baseline
Sam: nice improvement. can we check warm vs cold KV cache? noisy tails often due to cold cache populating
Alex: yes use the `--warm-cache` flag for bench to keep KV cache hot between runs
Mia: warm run done with --warm-cache — p50: 18ms, p95: 52ms. looks like cold KV cache was most of the delta
Jordan: summary: gap was NIC IRQ placement + cold KV cache. documenting in the parity notes
Priya: I'll open a small infra PR to enforce XPS/RPS on VPC hosts and add a validation check in the bootstrap
Sam: can someone add this to next week's parity sweep so we run the same bench across all vpc nodes? pinging eng-oncall for scheduling
Alex: nice work. Mia, drop the flamegraph link and the bench command used into the ticket
Mia: done — flamegraph: https://artifacts.redwood/graphs/2039998888/flame.svg; added bench command and exact env vars to the ticket
PerfBot: reminder: archived run artifacts at https://artifacts.redwood/2039998888/ (bench.out, flame.svg, env.txt)
Priya: :thumbsup: will follow up with PR and notes
Sam: thanks everyone. short-lived thread but good resolution :party:
